subject: Expired credits — request to extend evaluation window for Checkpoint AI
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <jordane@checkpoint.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credits expired during evaluation — can we get a short restart?

Hi Hannah,

We were running a benchmark against your hosted endpoint as part of our pre-procurement evaluation and noticed the promo credits on our account (Checkpoint AI) hit zero this morning. We still have a handful of long-form tests queued and a planned partner demo next week — losing access mid-eval would set us back.

Would Redwood be willing to provision a short one-time top-up (roughly 20k tokens) or extend the trial window by 10–14 days so we can finish the tests and the demo? Happy to share the account ID or estimated usage if that helps.

I've attached a small sample of the eval prompts (eval-sample.json) so you can see the remaining runbook.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Director of ML Infrastructure
Checkpoint AI
Attachment: eval-sample.json (2.1KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordane@checkpoint.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits expired during evaluation — can we get a short restart?

Hi Jordan — thanks for the note and the sample.

I can absolutely look into options. Quick asks to help us move faster: can you confirm your account ID and the three-day peak token estimate for the remaining tests? Also confirm whether the partner demo is internal-only or external-facing (we have slightly different approval flows).

Looping in Ben from billing and Marissa from CS to scope what we can offer as a one-time makegood.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Credits expired during evaluation — internal approval needed

Hannah / Marissa — quick internal note.

Account: Checkpoint AI (unverified procurement timeline). Jordan is asking for ~20k tokens or a 10–14 day extension. Standard playbook: for strategic PoCs we can offer up to 25k tokens as a one-time courtesy, or a 21-day trial extension. Need manager sign-off if we go beyond 20k tokens or add any monetary credits.

Recommend we offer a 21-day extension + 20k token top-up (expires at end of extension) and flag this as one-time only. If Marissa concurs from CS (we don't want to normalize restarts), I'll process the credit grant and draft a short mutual action note.

Ben
Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordane@checkpoint.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 07:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits expired during evaluation — can we get a short restart?

Hi Jordan — nice to meet you over email.

Thanks for the eval sample — that helped. We can offer a one-time top-up of 20,000 tokens with a 21-day window starting when we apply the credit. This will let you finish the queued runs and run the partner demo without interruption. A couple of notes:

- This is a one-time exception for Checkpoint AI while you complete procurement.
- Credits will be applied to the existing account and will not auto-renew.
- We request a short acknowledgement from procurement confirming the demo date and procurement timeline.

If that works for you, I will:
1) Apply the 20k token credit and set the expiry 21 days out,
2) Send a one-page makegood confirmation (attached: MA-plan.pdf) for your records, and
3) Share a DocuSign link if procurement needs to accept the terms.

Please reply with the account ID and a good contact for procurement and I’ll get this started today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MA-plan.pdf (8KB)
From: Jordan Ellis <jordane@checkpoint.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@checkpoint.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credits expired during evaluation — can we get a short restart?

Marissa — that plan works, thank you.

Account ID: CP-11987
Procurement contact: procurement@checkpoint.ai (they handle the MSA and PO). The partner demo is external-facing (customer demo with a potential systems integrator). We aim to run the demo on Oct 10, so the 21-day window is perfect.

Please apply the credit and send the makegood confirmation + DocuSign link to procurement@checkpoint.ai. Once they sign, we’ll confirm the demo slot.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Director of ML Infrastructure
Checkpoint AI
